name: 48323 · W Bloomfield, MI
findings: ZIP 48323 (W Bloomfield) has 100 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48323 (W Bloomfield) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
